title: Helwit Cola Extra Strong Nicotine Pouches 15mg / Pouch
description: Helwit Cola Nicotine Pouches (Extra Strong) serve up a sweet and satisfying flavour that's instantly recognisable. With smooth caramel notes and a gentle spice, this pouch captures the essence of classic cola sweets without being overpowering. It's a bright, nostalgic profile that's easy to enjoy, especially for fans of confectionery-inspired flavours. Each pouch contains 15mg of nicotine and is designed to sit comfortably and discreetly under the lip. Made from soft, plant-based materials, these pouches provide a gradual, long-lasting nicotine release with no smoke, vapour or odour. Produced in Sweden using sustainable practices, Helwit Cola Extra Strong offers a high-strength pouch with an approachable, everyday flavour. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH
